threat_event: Attacker logs in through the shared vendor account on the OT jump host and sends unauthorized open commands to feeder breakers
threat_source: Nation-state or cybercriminal group targeting utilities
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared standing vendor account; no MFA; no session approval; no monitoring of vendor sessions
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-003-9 R2 Att. 1 Sec. 6); Voluntary benchmark (NIST CSF 2.0; SP 800-82 Rev. 3)
existing_controls: Jump host sits in the OT DMZ; vendor passwords changed yearly
treatment_plan: Named vendor accounts with MFA; sessions enabled on request and time-limited; session recording and alerting; disable standing access

threat_event: Ransomware launched from the corporate network spreads across the IT/OT firewall and encrypts SCADA servers and HMIs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 legacy any rules between the corporate and SCADA networks; OT DMZ bypassed for OMS and historian traffic
existing_controls: EDR on corporate endpoints; SCADA servers in a separate OT domain
treatment_plan: Rebuild the IT/OT firewall rule base as deny by default; route all OMS and historian flows through the OT DMZ

threat_event: Attacker changes 115 kV relay settings through the vendor remote access path, causing a misoperation of BES line protection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CIP-003-9 Section 6 controls not implemented; relay passwords shared with the testing contractor
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 (Substation N and Substation E relays)
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-003-9 R2 Att. 1 Sec. 3.1 and Sec. 6)
existing_controls: Relay access lists at Substation N; relay setting changes checked at PRC-005 tests
treatment_plan: Implement Section 6 methods to determine, disable, and monitor vendor access; rotate relay passwords after each contractor visit

threat_event: SERC finds CIP-003-9 noncompliance at audit or through a complaint before the company self-reports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Section 6 not implemented by 2026-04-01; plan test missed 2026-06-14; contractor laptops not reviewed; open access list at Substation E
existing_controls: Compliance calendar kept by the NERC Compliance Coordinator
treatment_plan: Self-report to SERC by 2026-09-30 with mitigation plans; add the new CIP-003-9 dates to the compliance calendar

threat_event: Malware on a contractor relay-test laptop is introduced to low impact relays or the substation gateway
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No pre-connection review of contractor laptops; no removable media scanning station
existing_controls: Company relay laptops have antivirus and allowlisting
treatment_plan: Pre-connection checklist for contractor laptops; standalone media scanning kiosk at each operations center

threat_event: SCADA cannot be restored after ransomware or a disk failure because backups are lost with production or never worked
threat_source: Cybercriminal ransomware group or hardware failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups kept on the standby server in the same OT network; no offline copy; no restore test
existing_controls: Nightly database backups to the standby server
treatment_plan: Offline and immutable copies of SCADA database and configuration; quarterly restore test on a spare server

threat_event: Attacker exploits the unsupported operating system on two HMI consoles and the historian
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operating system past vendor support; no OT patch process
existing_controls: Consoles on the OT network only
treatment_plan: Vendor-supported upgrade of HMIs and historian; quarterly vendor-approved patch cycle; OT vulnerability review

threat_event: Former or current operator misuses a shared HMI account and the action cannot be traced to a person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared operator accounts on 6 HMIs; admin accounts never reviewed
existing_controls: DCC badge access; operator log book
treatment_plan: Named operator accounts with fast user switching; quarterly admin account review

threat_event: Stolen VPN password gives an attacker the corporate network and a path to the OT jump host
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy VPN with passwords only for 36 users; engineers reach the jump host from the VPN
existing_controls: Complex password policy; VPN logs kept 30 days
treatment_plan: Move VPN authentication to the identity provider with MFA; block jump host access from the VPN pool except named engineers

threat_event: Compromise of the AMI head-end used to send mass remote disconnect commands to meters
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote disconnect enabled on all meters; no company-side limit on bulk commands; AMI vendor contract has no security terms
existing_controls: AMI vendor SOC 2 Type 2 (reviewed in P09); MFA for AMI admin users
treatment_plan: Ask the vendor to enable bulk-command limits and two-person approval; add security terms at renewal

threat_event: Phishing leads to a compromised CIS user and theft of customer SSNs and bank account numbers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phishing exercises cover office staff only; CIS export rights broad
existing_controls: MFA for CIS and email; EDR
treatment_plan: Phishing training for all staff; restrict CIS bulk export to 3 named roles; export alerting

threat_event: Breach at the CIS vendor exposes customer SSNs and bank account numbers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer SSNs retained for all accounts, including closed ones
existing_controls: CIS vendor SOC 2 Type 2 on file
treatment_plan: Purge SSNs after the credit decision; contract notice within 72 hours

threat_event: Intruder enters a substation control house with an unrecovered key and tampers with equipment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Control house keys not tracked; 3 keys held by former employees
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-003-9 R2 Att. 1 Sec. 2); NERC EOP-004-4
existing_controls: Fences, locks, door alarms to the DCC
treatment_plan: Rekey control houses; key log with quarterly reconciliation; key return in the HR exit checklist

threat_event: Hurricane damages the headquarters and the DCC, and failover to the backup DCC fails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Failover last tested in 2023; backup DCC staffing plan outdated
existing_controls: Backup DCC at the North operations center; storm restoration plan
treatment_plan: Annual failover test before June 1; update backup DCC staffing and supplies

threat_event: Hurricane damage to cellular networks cuts off crews from the OMS during restoration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets depend on commercial cellular; no offline OMS mode tested
existing_controls: Two-way radio for crew dispatch
treatment_plan: Test tablet offline mode; satellite backup for 4 crew leader trucks

threat_event: Cloud administrator account taken over and the OMS workloads deleted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two admin accounts with standing access
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for cloud admins; backup vault in a separate account
treatment_plan: Accepted by the President and CEO: residual risk Low

threat_event: OMS-SCADA integration fails during a storm so breaker events do not reach the OMS and restoration slows
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single integration server; no queue monitoring
existing_controls: Operators can enter outages manually
treatment_plan: Integration health alarms in the DCC; documented manual entry procedure

threat_event: Load forecast error leads to costly day-ahead purchases or an inadequate peak-day operating plan
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No documented validation, drift monitoring, or change control
existing_controls: Manager of Power Supply reviews forecasts before scheduling
treatment_plan: Model validation, error monitoring, and change control (see P10)
owner: Manager of Power Supply and Rates

threat_event: Weather data feed or training data is tampered with so the forecast is skewed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No integrity checks on the weather feed; analytics workspace shared by 3 users with one key
existing_controls: Weather feed over TLS from a commercial provider
treatment_plan: Range and plausibility checks on inputs; named workspace accounts (see P10)

threat_event: Adversary pre-positions in the OT network and remains undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT security monitoring; logs not collected
existing_controls: None in OT
treatment_plan: Passive OT network monitoring at the DCC and the two BES substations; log collection to the log workspace with weekly review

threat_event: A compromised SCADA vendor update or patch package introduces malicious code
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No hash verification of vendor packages; removable media used for transfers
existing_controls: Vendor signs its installers
treatment_plan: Verify signatures and hashes before install; transfer through the DMZ file server with scanning

threat_event: Incident notifications to DOE, the E-ISAC, or NERC are late because nobody knows the clocks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DOE-417 and E-ISAC steps missing from the IT incident plan; low impact plan untested
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-003-9 R2 Att. 1 Sec. 4.2); NERC EOP-004-4 R2; DOE-417
existing_controls: EOP-004 Operating Plan in the DCC
treatment_plan: Notification matrix (P08) posted in the DCC; tabletop by 2026-10-30

threat_event: Lost or stolen truck tablet exposes OMS access and customer contact details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets unlock with a 4-digit PIN; OMS session stays signed in
existing_controls: Device encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: 6-digit PIN; OMS session timeout of 30 minutes

threat_event: Spoofed radio or cellular traffic sends DNP3 commands to field reclosers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DNP3 without authentication on licensed radio and private cellular links
existing_controls: Private APN for cellular; radio licenses
treatment_plan: Evaluate DNP3 secure authentication or VPN tunnels at radio and cellular sites in the 2027 budget

threat_event: Engineer error in a relay setting change causes a misoperation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No peer review or change record for relay setting changes
existing_controls: Settings files kept on the engineering server
treatment_plan: Two-person review and change record for every relay setting change

threat_event: Customer portal accounts taken over by credential stuffing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal MFA optional for customers
existing_controls: Vendor bot and rate limiting; no SSN display in portal
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low; vendor-managed

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a wholesale power payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank change requests accepted by email
existing_controls: MFA on email; dual approval of wires
treatment_plan: Call-back verification of every bank change using a known number

threat_event: CIP evidence is not retained for three calendar years, so compliance cannot be shown at audit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Evidence scattered in email and personal folders
existing_controls: Compliance calendar
treatment_plan: Central CIP evidence repository with a 3-year retention rule

threat_event: The only SCADA/OT Administrator is unavailable during an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds SCADA admin knowledge and passwords
existing_controls: SCADA vendor 24x7 support line
treatment_plan: Cross-train the OT technician; sealed break-glass credentials in the DCC safe

threat_event: Malware on removable media used for SCADA file transfers infects an HMI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: USB drives used for transfers; no scanning station
existing_controls: Antivirus on HMIs (signatures updated monthly)
treatment_plan: Scanning kiosk (shared with R-005); block USB storage on HMIs

threat_event: Attacker already on the OT network reaches the Substation E relays through the open gateway access list
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Substation E gateway permitted any routable traffic from the OT network (found in P07 testing 2026-08-12)
existing_controls: Access list corrected 2026-08-13
treatment_plan: Keep the corrected list; post-commissioning access list check in the substation change procedure
